search_paths.description: List of directory paths to search for OpenOffice/LibreOffice documents.

file_extensions.description: List of file extensions to treat as Office documents for indexing.

min_term_length.description: Minimum character length for search terms to be valid.

case_insensitive.description: Whether search terms should be case-insensitive.

max_depth.description: Maximum directory depth to recurse into when searching.

ignore_hidden.description: Whether to ignore files and directories starting with a dot.
